# Akarsh Mishra

> Personal portfolio of Akarsh Mishra, a Computer Science and Engineering student at Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University (SRMU), Lucknow, India. The site presents software projects, academic work, technical skills, certificates, and contact information.

## Canonical pages
- [Portfolio home](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/): profile, projects, education, experience, and contact.
- [Projects](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/#projects): project cards and case studies.
- [Academic details](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/#academic): education and academic records.
- [Experience](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/#experience): internship and event context.
- [Certificates](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/#certifications-gallery): certificates and documents.
- [Resume](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/Akarsh_Mishra_Resume.pdf): downloadable resume.
- [Contact](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/#service-enquiry): service enquiry form.

## Profile
Akarsh Mishra studies Computer Science and Engineering at SRMU. Areas represented on this site include full-stack web development, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, backend APIs, and applied AI/ML. The portfolio describes projects and experience; project features should be checked against each linked repository and current deployment.

## Selected projects
- [WeatherGPT](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/weathergpt): weather-focused AI project associated with Smart India Hackathon.
- [NeuroTrack AI](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/neurotrack-ai): cognitive-load and fatigue estimation project; outputs are not medical diagnoses.
- [ENROLE](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/enrole): incomplete repository record; recruitment workflows are not verified as implemented.
- [PrepBot.AI](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/prepbot): learning-platform prototype associated with HackWithUP; some routes are placeholders.
- [MedRx](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/medrx): medical-report interpretation project; not a substitute for professional medical advice.
- [FrameSutra](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/framesutra): video workspace project.
- [GreenPath](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/green-path): proposed lower-pollution routing concept associated with TechFest; routing features remain roadmap items.
- [Sparsh Trading](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/sparsh-trading): client business website.
- [Mahakal Swarn Builder](https://code-akarshmishra.vercel.app/projects/mahakalswarnbuilder): client real-estate website.
